cases.sentence: Славьте ___ все народы, пойте хвалу Ему все люди.
cases.translation: Praise the Lord, all nations! Sing praises to Him, all people!
cases.explain: The verb славьте (praise) is transitive and takes the accusative case for its direct object; for animate nouns, accusative looks like genitive.

cases.sentence: Славьте Господа все ___, пойте хвалу Ему все люди.
cases.translation: Praise the Lord, all nations! Sing praises to Him, all people!
cases.explain: The noun народы (nations) is the subject of the imperative sentence and stands in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Славьте Господа все народы, пойте ___ Ему все люди.
cases.translation: Praise the Lord, all nations! Sing praises to Him, all people!
cases.explain: The verb пойте (sing) is transitive and takes the accusative case for its direct object; хвалу is the accusative form of хвала.

cases.sentence: Потому что велика Его ___ к нам и истина Его навеки.
cases.translation: For His mercy toward us is great and His truth endures forever.
cases.explain: The noun милость (mercy) is the subject of the verb велика (is great) and stands in nominative case.

reading.ru: Славьте Господа все народы, пойте хвалу Ему все люди.
reading.question: Who is called upon to praise God in this verse?
reading.explain: The text explicitly says 'все народы' (all nations) and 'все люди' (all people) should praise the Lord.

reading.ru: Потому что велика Его милость к нам и истина Его навеки.
reading.question: Why should all people praise the Lord?
options: Because His mercy is great toward us and His truth endures forever
Because He has given us wealth and power
Because He has made us rulers of the earth
Because He has protected us from all enemies
reading.correct: Because His mercy is great toward us and His truth endures forever
reading.explain: The text gives two reasons: the greatness of God's mercy 'велика Его милость' and the enduring nature of His truth 'истина Его навеки.'

reading.ru: Славьте Господа все народы, пойте хвалу Ему все люди, потому что велика Его милость к нам и истина Его навеки.
reading.question: What is the main theme of this verse?
options: Universal call to praise God for His eternal mercy and truth
Praise offered by the righteous to God
Singing in the temple with instruments
reading.correct: Universal call to praise God for His eternal mercy and truth
reading.explain: The entire verse is a universal call (all nations, all people) to praise God because of His great mercy and eternal truth.
